title: Wasserstein Robust Classification Error: Surrogate Loss Misalignment and Distributional Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2510.10000v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization (WDRO) provides a framework for evaluating model robustness through the worst-case expectation in the Wasserstein ball around a reference distribution. We prove that ordering hypotheses by increasing WDRO risk is equivalent to ordering them by decreasing robust accuracy if and only if the loss function is a positive multiple of the zero-one loss plus a label-dependent offset. For a class of loss functions including cross-entropy, we show that a hypothesis with perfect robust accuracy can conversely have a higher WDRO risk than another hypothesis with near zero robust accuracy. translated_title: Wasserstein鲁棒分类误差：代理损失失配与分布攻击
translated_abstract: Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化（WDRO）提供了一个通过参考分布周围Wasserstein球内最坏情况期望来评估模型鲁棒性的框架。我们证明，按WDRO风险递增对假设排序等价于按鲁棒准确率递减对假设排序，当且仅当损失函数是0-1损失的正倍数加上一个标签相关的偏移量。对于包括交叉熵在内的一类损失函数，我们证明了一个鲁棒准确率完美的假设反而可能比鲁棒准确率接近于零的假设具有更高的WDRO风险。为了直接评估鲁棒准确率，我们开发了Wasserstein分布攻击（WDA），它在候选支撑点搜索之后增加一个权重生成阶段，以在Wasserstein约束下优化经验质量（概率质量）的分配，而不是将每个数据点的全部质量分配给单一返回的攻击点。
tldr: 本文证明了仅当损失函数是0-1损失的正倍数加标签相关偏移时，WDRO风险的排序才与鲁棒准确率的排序一致（交叉熵等常用损失存在失配问题），并提出Wasserstein分布攻击（WDA）来直接评估鲁棒准确率。
